hindu-scriptures.title: Rigveda: The Book of Eternal Hymns

hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: The Rigveda is the foundational pillar of ancient wisdom. Its 1,028 hymns capture the primal awe of creation, divine light, and the eternal laws governing the cosmos.

hindu-scriptures.title: Samaveda: The Veda of Sacred Chants & Melodies
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Veda Vyasa
hindu-scriptures.description: The Veda of sacred music and divine chanting. Sets the verses of the Rigveda to celestial musical notes, forming the origin of classical Indian music.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Lord Krishna Himself states in the Bhagavad Gita: 'Among the Vedas, I am the Samaveda.' It elevates prayer into sublime celestial music.

hindu-scriptures.title: Yajurveda: The Veda of Sacrificial Wisdom & Rituals
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Veda Vyasa (Shukla & Krishna Recensions)
hindu-scriptures.description: The sacred guidebook for Vedic rituals, Yagyas, mantras, and meditative offerings. Divided into Shukla (White) and Krishna (Black) Yajurveda.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: The Yajurveda transforms outward ritual into inner spiritual sacrifice, containing the sacred Isha Upanishad and Shatapatha Brahmana.

hindu-scriptures.title: Atharvaveda: The Veda of Healing, Charms & Everyday Life
hindu-scriptures.author: Rishi Atharvan & Rishi Angiras
hindu-scriptures.description: The Veda of daily living, Ayurvedic medicine, protection mantras, statecraft, and profound cosmological hymns including the Prithvi Sukta.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Atharvaveda connects high spiritual metaphysics with practical wellness, medicine, and deep reverence for Mother Earth in the Prithvi Sukta.

hindu-scriptures.title: Srimad Bhagavad Gita: The Song of God
hindu-scriptures.author: Sri Krishna & Maharishi Veda Vyasa
hindu-scriptures.description: The 700-verse divine dialogue between Bhagavan Sri Krishna and Arjuna on the battlefield of Kurukshetra, illuminating Karma Yoga, Bhakti Yoga, and Jnana Yoga.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: The Bhagavad Gita is the essence of all Upanishadic wisdom. In just 18 chapters, Sri Krishna reveals how to live without fear, master your mind, and achieve supreme liberation.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Principal Upanishads
hindu-scriptures.author: Ancient Vedic Seers (Ed. Dr. S. Radhakrishnan)
hindu-scriptures.description: The 108 philosophical treatises revealing the ultimate non-dual reality (Brahman) and the inner divine Self (Atman). Features Isha, Kena, Katha, Chandogya, and Brihadaranyaka.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: The Upanishads contain the sublime Mahavakyas: 'Tat Tvam Asi' (That Thou Art) and 'Aham Brahmasmi'. They represent the peak of human philosophical inquiry.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Valmiki Ramayana
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Valmiki
hindu-scriptures.description: The immortal Adi Kavya epic detailing the noble life, righteousness (Dharma), and heroic saga of Bhagavan Sri Rama, Devi Sita, and Shri Hanuman.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Valmiki's Ramayana is the heartbeat of Indian culture. It illustrates Maryada (righteous boundaries), filial devotion, and the ultimate victory of truth over evil.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Mahabharata (18 Parvas Complete)
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Veda Vyasa
hindu-scriptures.description: The world's greatest epic comprising 100,000 verses. Explores righteousness, duty, royal conflict, philosophy, and destiny through the Kuru dynasty.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: It is rightly said: 'What is found here may be found elsewhere, but what is not found here is nowhere else.' A masterwork on human nature and cosmic order.

hindu-scriptures.title: Srimad Bhagavatam (Bhagavata Purana)
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Veda Vyasa
hindu-scriptures.description: The crown jewel of Puranic literature detailing the 24 Avatara divine incarnations of Lord Vishnu, the lilas of Sri Krishna, and devotion (Bhakti).
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Srimad Bhagavatam is pure nectar for the spiritual seeker. It transforms philosophical abstraction into profound emotional devotion and divine ecstasy.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Shiva Purana
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Veda Vyasa
hindu-scriptures.description: The sacred purana celebrating the cosmic dance, meditation, origins, Jyotirlingas, and grace of Bhagavan Shiva and Goddess Parvati.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: The Shiva Purana explores Mahadeva as both the unmanifest transcendent void and the compassionate Lord of Mount Kailash.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Vishnu Purana
hindu-scriptures.author: Rishi Parashara & Veda Vyasa
hindu-scriptures.description: One of the most authentic Puranas describing the creation of the cosmos, the Manvantaras, the genealogies of kings, and the preserver Lord Vishnu.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Rishi Parashara's exposition is prized by scholars for its detailed cosmology, time cycles (Yugas), and vivid narrative structure.

hindu-scriptures.title: Devi Mahatmyam & Markandeya Purana
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Markandeya
hindu-scriptures.description: The sacred 700 verses (Durga Saptashati) depicting the victory of Supreme Goddess Durga over Mahishasura, symbolizing the destruction of ego.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Devi Mahatmyam is the core scripture of Shaktism, exalting the Divine Mother as the supreme cosmic energy (Parashakti) protecting all creation.

hindu-scriptures.title: Yoga Sutras of Patanjali
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Patanjali
hindu-scriptures.description: The 196 aphorisms outlining Ashtanga Yoga (8 limbs of yoga), mind control, Samadhi, and spiritual liberation.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Patanjali defines yoga as 'Yogas Chitta Vritti Nirodha' — the stilling of the fluctuations of the mind. A scientific manual for consciousness.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Ashtavakra Gita
hindu-scriptures.author: Sage Ashtavakra & King Janaka
hindu-scriptures.description: The uncompromising Advaita Vedanta text revealing immediate enlightenment, self-realization, and detachment from worldly illusions.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Ashtavakra Gita speaks directly to pure awareness. It removes all mental concepts, urging you to realize right now that you are free.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Yoga Vasistha
hindu-scriptures.author: Sage Vasistha & Sri Rama
hindu-scriptures.description: A profound philosophical dialogue where Sage Vasistha instructs young Prince Rama on the illusory nature of the world, Maya, and enlightenment.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Yoga Vasistha is filled with captivating allegories and deep metaphysical insights on mind, space, time, and supreme realization.

hindu-scriptures.title: Chanakya Neeti & Arthashastra
hindu-scriptures.author: Acharya Chanakya (Kautilya)
hindu-scriptures.description: The ancient treatise on statecraft, diplomacy, political strategy, economics, ethics, and leadership by the mentor of Chandragupta Maurya.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Chanakya's maxims remain sharp and practical to this day. A classic guide on governance, shrewd strategy, and personal wisdom.

hindu-scriptures.title: Manusmriti & The Dharma Shastras
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Manu
hindu-scriptures.description: Ancient legal and ethical treatise examining duty, governance, social organization, and righteousness across cosmic ages.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: An important historical code of law and societal ethics from ancient India, reflecting the intricate social ideals of its era.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Garuda Purana
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Veda Vyasa
hindu-scriptures.description: The sacred Purana detailing the soul's journey after death, Karma, reincarnation, funeral rites (Preta Kalpa), and liberation.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Garuda Purana answers the eternal questions about life, death, karmic consequences, and how the soul transitions between realms.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Skanda Purana
hindu-scriptures.author: Maharishi Veda Vyasa
hindu-scriptures.description: The largest Purana celebrating Lord Murugan (Kartikeya), Kashi, Kedarnath, Rameswaram, and the sacred geography of India.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: A grand pilgrimage through India's holy places, rich in stories of Lord Murugan, Shiva's temples, and spiritual penance.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Agni Purana

hindu-scriptures.description: An encyclopedic Purana delivered by Agni Dev, covering architecture, temple arts, medicine, warfare, grammar, and devotion.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Agni Purana is a vast compendium of ancient Indian science, martial strategy, architecture, and spiritual rituals.

hindu-scriptures.title: Narada Bhakti Sutras

hindu-scriptures.title: Ramcharitmanas

hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Tulsidas brought the divine story of Sri Rama into the hearts and homes of millions through sweet, poetic devotion.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Brahma Sutras

hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: The Brahma Sutras, together with the Upanishads and Bhagavad Gita, form the Prasthanatrayi — the triple foundation of Hindu philosophy.

hindu-scriptures.title: The Avadhuta Gita

hindu-scriptures.title: Thirukkural

hindu-scriptures.description: 1,330 Tamil couplets organized into Aram (Virtue), Porul (Wealth), and Inbam (Love), recognized universally as a secular moral masterwork.
hindu-scriptures.librarianComment: Thirukkural provides practical ethical guidance for kings, householders, and spiritual seekers alike, transcending sectarian boundaries.

hindu-scriptures.title: Lalita Sahasranama & Saundarya Lahari
